author: Bella S
text:
During a recent trip to the hospital, I had the chance to visit the second branch of Zuru restaurant, and it certainly left a positive impression. The meal consisted of a crunchy roll, cold udon, and stir-fried pork, each dish highlighting the restaurant's commitment to quality ingredients and expert preparation.

Starting with the seafood, the freshness was top-notch. The ika and white fish were especially remarkable, melting softly in the mouth. The chef’s precision in cutting the ika made it easy to chew and enhanced the overall dining experience.

The cold udon was a comforting dish, they were tender with just the right amount of seasoning to bring the dish together. It provided a subtle yet satisfying contrast to the more robust flavours of the other dishes.

The crunchy roll was a standout. The tempura flakes were fluffy and crispy on the outside, while the inside was packed with flavourful meat and perfectly seasoned rice. This dish was a great example of how texture and flavour can harmonise in a simple yet delicious way.

Lastly, the stir-fried pork with vegetables was well-executed. The pork was tender and well-marinated, though it leaned a bit on the sweeter side for my taste. Nonetheless, the chef’s selection of meat was excellent, ensuring that the pork remained juicy and not too dry even on the barbecue plate.

Overall, I was quite impressed with the quality and freshness of the ingredients at Zuru. This second branch continues to uphold the standards set by the original, making it a worthy destination for anyone seeking authentic Japanese flavours.
